sectionDescription: Configure DingTalk bot Webhook to receive system notifications
fieldEnabledDesc: When enabled, the system will send notifications via DingTalk bot
fieldWebhookUrlDesc: Webhook URL of DingTalk custom bot
fieldSecretDesc: Signing secret of DingTalk bot for verifying message origin
toastTestSuccess: Test message sent successfully. Please check your DingTalk group.
step1Item1: Open DingTalk group → Group settings → Smart assistants → Add bot
step2Item1: Recommended to choose “Signature” and save generated secret
step2Item2: You can also choose “Custom keyword” or “IP allowlist”
step3Item2: Fill in Webhook URL and secret (if any) into the config above
